summary: Iteration 4 — Team Console + status emails + Home membership section + all-5-tiers Membership + real Docs PDF. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed against the public URL — POST /api/admin/verify (200 with correct X-Admin-Key, 401 on wrong/missing), GET /api/admin/memberships (401 without key, returns full records incl. name/email/message, filter ?status=... honoured, invalid status → 422), PATCH /api/memberships/{id}/status (401 without key, 422 for invalid status, transitions pending_review→in_review→approved and pending_review→declined, idempotent when re-applying same status → 200, unknown id → 404), public GET /api/memberships/{id}/status returns id/institution/tier/region/status/date/updated_at only (no name/email). Regression: POST /api/memberships still returns Certificate with correct amount_usd for all 5 tiers; /api/memberships/totals still returns {total, by_region{europe,united_states,algeria,middle_east_gulf,brics,africa}}. Backend log confirmed 'HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted' from https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send on POST /api/memberships (2 emails: applicant + team) and on PATCH status change (1 email). NOTE: rapid PATCH loop in tests briefly hit 429 Too Many Requests from the email proxy — expected under burst, not a code bug. Frontend (390x844, EN + AR): Home shows the smaller hero image with the EN tagline 'NUR Energy Settlement Unit' beneath (not overlapping), a new 'home-membership' section with cards image + all 5 tappable rows home-tier-bronze/silver/gold/diamond/platinum + home-membership-cta; tapping any row or the CTA navigates to /membership. Membership tab: tier-cards contains all five cards tier-bronze..tier-platinum visible on a 390-wide viewport without horizontal scroll; tapping tier-gold updates tier-benefits copy accordingly. Docs: doc-proposal opens (no 'Preview copy' pill anywhere — DOCUMENTS all have standin:false). Footer team-console-link visible on every screen. Team console: wrong key shows team-key-invalid; correct key opens team-console with filter chips filter-all/filter-pending_review/filter-in_review/filter-approved/filter-declined; found 5 real request cards; tapping a set-{status}-{id} action fired window.confirm (auto-accepted), status pill updated (Declined → Pending review), toast 'Status updated and applicant notified.' shown; team-lock returned to the key screen. AR run confirmed 'لوحة الفريق' title, 'فتح' unlock button, RTL layout (html dir='rtl'), AR tagline 'وحدة تسوية الطاقة نور' on Home, and 'لوحة الفريق' footer link. Copy audit: 0 occurrences of 'pledge', 'Pledge', 'symbolic', or 'Preview copy' anywhere in rendered EN/FR/AR Home + Docs + Team pages. No React Native red-screen; no console errors (only a benign 401 response from the intentional wrong-key attempt).
action_items: RESET SHARED COUNTER — this test run inserted 2 new TEST_* membership records (1 bronze/europe, 1 gold/africa) via the pytest suite. Combined with any prior TEST_* rows this iteration lands on top of, the memberships collection now contains those + previous seed data. Main agent should clear (or delete TEST_*-prefixed rows in) the `memberships` collection before hand-off so the /membership counter reads 0.

OPTIONAL: the Emergent email proxy returned 429 Too Many Requests for a few PATCH-triggered emails during the burst of transition tests. The membership submission path is unaffected (both applicant+team emails on POST returned 202). Consider a small in-process retry-with-backoff in emailer.send_email for 429s if this becomes visible in production.

OPTIONAL cleanup: dead i18n key 'doc_standin' remains in strings.ts (EN 'Preview copy' / FR 'Copie de prévisualisation' / AR 'نسخة معاينة') and is referenced by research.tsx:66 inside an `if (d.standin)` branch that is now always false. Currently harmless — it is never rendered — but you can remove both the key and the branch to keep the codebase clean.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still compact (<240 lines), keeps _id excluded via projection, uses env vars only, and uses find_one_and_update with a $ne guard so a same-status PATCH is naturally idempotent and does not fire an email.
emailer.py runs a solid structural guardrail before every send (no forms, https-only links, no credential-ask phrases, anchor-vs-href host match).

team.tsx correctly handles web vs native confirm dialog (window.confirm on web, Alert.alert elsewhere), stores the key in AsyncStorage on web and SecureStore on native, and locks on UnauthorizedError.
Footer.tsx exposes the team console entry point via testID team-console-link on every screen, RTL-aware.

All new interactive elements carry testIDs (home-tier-*, home-membership, home-membership-cta, tier-cards, team-console, team-key-input, team-unlock, team-lock, team-key-invalid, filter-*, request-{id}, status-{id}, set-{status}-{id}, team-console-link).
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created 2 TEST_* membership records (1 bronze/europe with status transitioned pending_review → in_review → approved; 1 gold/africa transitioned to declined). Main agent should reset the memberships collection before hand-off.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team console + status emails validated end-to-end. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_team_console.py (run with `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_team_console.py -v -o addopts=''` to disable xdist since the suite shares an in-memory CREATED_IDS list across ordered tests). ADMIN_KEY is in /app/backend/.env and mirrored in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Public URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Copy audit is clean in EN/FR/AR (no pledge/symbolic/Preview copy). One optional dead i18n key doc_standin remains but is never rendered because DOCUMENTS entries all have standin:false.
